computer_use_url_confidence_diagnosis.code_fix: Frontend setupTabs now preserves or restores ?tab=content when the hash targets an admin content section; launcher control test already asserts the canonical URL; production-launcher docs now name the canonical URL.
computer_use_url_confidence_diagnosis.computer_use_missing_signal: Windows Computer Use policy could not independently read/verify the Chrome address-bar URL from the browser window state; it had title/window evidence but no trusted URL signal.
computer_use_url_confidence_diagnosis.root_cause: The launcher control path requested the canonical URL, but the running production server still served older frontend setupTabs code that removed tab=content on load; Computer Use then stopped because it could not independently verify the browser URL for policy enforcement.
